primitives.subtask: File the auto collision claim under POL-AUTO-2020-11847

steps.action: Choose “POL-AUTO-2020-11847 - Auto” in the “policy number” menu
Set the “date of incident” field to “2026-05-08”
Type “2026-05-08” in the “date of incident” field
Type “Main” in the “Address or location” field
Type “Main St, Lakeport, QW” in the “Address or location” field
Type “Main St, Lakeport, WA” in the “Address or location” field
Type “I got bumped in the back by a Toyota Camry 2014” in the “Describe what happened...” field
